description: A shell script for testing session ID capabilities in a Git repository, including setup, enabling SID advertisement, and verifying SID exchange during fetch and push operations across multiple protocol versions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
